description: Use when writing or editing any human-facing prose -- documentation, READMEs, blog posts, PR/commit descriptions, comments, release notes, or chat replies meant to be published. A catalog of recognizable AI writing tells (e.g. "delve", "it's not X -- it's Y", em-dash addiction, bold-first bullets, signposted conclusions) to review the text against and rewrite so it reads like a human wrote it.
